about_the_game:
"Hello and welcome to the 'Hanwoon Museum of Art,' which is not available."

N/A Museum is a first-person horror exploration game.

The player becomes "Kang Min-soo," a search worker,

Exploring the sealed Hanun Museum of Art, he encountered a strange phenomenon,

We need to find the truth of the past and the clues to escape.

This game goes beyond just a horror experience,

The player observes and interprets the 'rules' of strange beings

It aims to survive.

It was once an open space for everyone.

But a few years ago, it was closed due to an unidentified fire, and now it's a sealed art museum that no one should enter.

However, someone came inside, just like you.

In the Hanwoon Museum of Art, where the unknown exists, you have to become Kang Min-soo, a search worker, find the truth of the case, and find out how to escape.

Gather information from your notebook and have a conversation with visitors at the museum.

Your life depends on this conversation.

Collect the notes left by the search crews from all over the map.

These notes will help you learn the truth of this place.

Be careful not to get caught by the curator. I'm keeping an eye on you.

The rules you have uncovered are the key to survival.

Will I be able to get out of the museum?

Or... Simply Remaining Another Missing Person? Reveal the truth of art museums.

short_description: Welcome to Hanun Art Museum. The rules here are ever-changing. In this enigmatic museum, shrouded in mystery, you step into the shoes of Kang Min-soo, an Anomaly Investigator determined to uncover the truth behind a series of strange phenomena—and find a way to escape.
